aboutHeadline: Igniting Curiosity. Empowering Voices. Translating Research into Impact.
aboutParagraph1: SciComm Spark is Egypt’s premier national youth science communication competition, organized and spearheaded by the Science Communication Club at Alamein International University (AIU). Following a groundbreaking inaugural season within AIU, the competition enters its 2nd Edition, expanding nationwide across all Egyptian governorates to discover, train, and elevate the country's most promising scientific storytellers. Serving as the competitive heartbeat of the annual SciComm Nexus forum, SciComm Spark transforms complex scientific concepts into captivating, accessible narratives—empowering student creators and young researchers to take center stage and drive civic science literacy.
aboutParagraph2Title: SciComm Spark at "SciComm Nexus": The Grand Stage
aboutParagraph2: SciComm Spark culminates live at SciComm Nexus: Science Communication for Public Engagement and Capacity Building, a landmark annual forum co-organized by Alamein International University (AIU) and the Sustainable Development Studies and Youth Capacity Building Program at the Bibliotheca Alexandrina. Held in the historic Great Hall of the Bibliotheca Alexandrina Conference Center, SciComm Nexus brings together university leadership, world-class researchers, digital creators, media professionals, and hundreds of passionate attendees to celebrate the transformative power of science communication.

aboutHighlights.text: Historic Venue & Partnership: Jointly hosted at the Bibliotheca Alexandrina alongside AIU leadership
Nationwide Media Spotlight: Broadcasted and covered extensively by 15+ television channels and leading regional newspapers.
The Live Final Stage: Out of 94 original student competitors across AIU faculties, 13 elite teams (26 student advocates) earned their place to present live on stage during the SciComm Spark finale.

track1Stages: Phase 1 (Short-Form Reel): Produce a high-impact, 90-second video (Reels/TikTok) presenting a core scientific idea clearly and creatively.
Phase 2 (In-Depth Video): Create a 3-minute YouTube video delivering deeper narrative structure and scientific storytelling.
Grand Final (Live Science Show): Deliver a 5-minute live science demonstration and video showcase on stage in front of national judges, scientific experts, and live audience.
track2Stages: Phase 1 (Research & Interviews): Conduct journalistic research and interview specialist researchers and academics.

Phase 2 (Article Publication): Write a professional, simplified science article published on SciComm Spark's digital platform, with top pieces submitted for publication in official newspapers and science magazines.
Grand Final (Live Journalism Show): Finalists conduct a live, interactive scientific interview on stage before the jury and audience, simulating professional science talk shows.
